## Story Goal

Switch the `/browse` surface to the new visual language without changing how any other route looks:

1. `/browse` uses dark navy surfaces (`#0B1020` / `#151D30` / `#202C43`) with a cyan accent (`#67E8F9`). **No red accent remains on browse.**
2. Typography, spacing, radii, the focus ring, touch targets, and motion on browse all come from tokens.
3. Movie cards show the rating as value, scale, and source (e.g. "6.5 / 10 · IMDb"). Missing poster, year, or rating each get a labelled placeholder.
4. Auth, home/dashboard, and account routes look **exactly the same as before**.

**Not in scope:** data fetching, the `CatalogAdapter` contract, routing, the backend, search/filters/pagination, and changing the header across the whole app.

**No backend changes required.**

### 1 — Add the browse theme scope

**File:** the MB-01 theme module, which Task 0 is expected to show is `MoviePlatform/Frontend/frontend layer/src/styles.css`.

Add a scoped block **after** the existing `:root` tokens. **Reuse MB-01's existing property names** so components pick up the new values without code changes. The names below are placeholders: replace each `--<mb01-…>` with the real name found in Task 0. Add new properties (the `--browse-…` / generic ones below) only where MB-01 has no equivalent.

```css
/* MB-02 — browse theme scope. Only elements inside [data-theme="browse"] see these values. */
[data-theme="browse"] {
  --<mb01-bg>: #0B1020;
  --<mb01-surface>: #151D30;
  --<mb01-surface-elevated>: #202C43;
  --<mb01-text-primary>: #F4F7FC;
  --<mb01-text-secondary>: #B6C2D6;
  --<mb01-accent>: #67E8F9;
  --<mb01-on-accent>: #07141C;
  --<mb01-border-decorative>: #34425A;
  --<mb01-border-control>: #71839E;
  --<mb01-focus>: #FCD34D;
  --<mb01-error>: #FDA4AF;

  --font-family-base: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-body-size: 1rem;        --font-body-lh: 1.5;
  --font-meta-size: 0.875rem;    --font-meta-lh: 1.45;
  --font-card-title-size: 1rem;  --font-card-title-weight: 600;
  --font-heading-size: clamp(1.5rem, 1rem + 2vw, 2.5rem);

  --space-1: 4px;  --space-2: 8px;  --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px;
  --space-5: 24px; --space-6: 32px; --space-7: 48px; --space-8: 64px;

  --radius-control: 8px; --radius-card: 12px; --radius-dialog: 16px; --radius-chip: 999px;

  --focus-ring-width: 3px; --focus-ring-offset: 3px;
  --touch-target-min: 44px;
  --motion-fast: 120ms; --motion-base: 180ms;

  background: var(--<mb01-bg>);
  color: var(--<mb01-text-primary>);
  font-family: var(--font-family-base);
  font-size: var(--font-body-size);
  line-height: var(--font-body-lh);
}

[data-theme="browse"] :is(a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]):focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--<mb01-focus>);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-theme="browse"] *,
  [data-theme="browse"] *::before,
  [data-theme="browse"] *::after {
    transition: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
  }
}
```

- **Do not** change any `:root` value. Changing one would alter non-browse routes.
- If MB-01 already defines spacing, radius, or font tokens, override those names instead of adding the `--space-*` / `--radius-*` names above. **Do not end up with two parallel token sets.**

### 2 — Apply the scope on the browse route

**File:** `MoviePlatform/Frontend/frontend layer/src/app/features/browse/browse.component.ts`

- Add `host: { 'data-theme': 'browse' }` to the `@Component` metadata. If `host` already exists, merge into it. Make the host fill the viewport (`:host { display: block; min-height: 100vh; }`) so the `#0B1020` background covers the whole page.
- **If Task 0 shows the header is rendered outside the browse component** (in the `app.ts` shell or a layout component), the header is outside the scope. In that case, set `data-theme="browse"` on the shell element only while the active route is `/browse`. Do this with a small binding in the shell that reads `Router` URL events. Do **not** change header markup for other routes. Record which option you used in the PR.

### 3 — Replace literals in browse styles with tokens

**File:** `browse.component.ts`, plus any component it renders that Task 0 found.

- Replace every raw hex colour, `px` spacing literal, and `font-size` literal from the Task 0 baseline with `var(--…)` tokens.
- Use only the spacing values in the scale (4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64). Round any ad-hoc value to the nearest scale step.
- Page heading: `font-size: var(--font-heading-size)`.
- Metadata (year, rating, genre chips): meta size and line height, colour `text-secondary`.
- Radii: buttons and inputs use `--radius-control`, cards and posters use `--radius-card`, dialogs use `--radius-dialog`, chips use `--radius-chip`.
- Every interactive element (nav links, buttons, chips, card links): `min-width` and `min-height` of `var(--touch-target-min)`. Use padding or inline-flex so the visible size does not jump.
- Hover and focus transitions on cards and buttons: `transition: <prop> var(--motion-fast|--motion-base) ease`. Only `transform`, `box-shadow`, `background-color` and `border-color` may be transitioned.
- The primary action button (currently red): `background: var(<accent>)`, `color: var(<on-accent>)`, `border-radius: var(--radius-control)`.
- Borders: `border-control` on control outlines (inputs, chips, secondary buttons). `border-decorative` is **only** for dividers or card outlines that carry no meaning (see the contrast edge case).
- Card surfaces use `surface`. Hover state, dialogs, and menus use `surface-elevated`.

### 4 — Movie card: rating and placeholders

**File:** the card markup in `browse.component.ts` (or the card component, if Task 0 finds one). Use the formatter in `MoviePlatform/Frontend/frontend layer/src/app/core/catalog/catalog-display.ts` if one already exists.

- Card layout: poster (`border-radius: var(--radius-card)`, fixed aspect ratio such as `aspect-ratio: 2 / 3`, `object-fit: cover`), then the title (card-title style), then one metadata line in `text-secondary`.
- Rating text format: `"{value} / {scale} · {source}"`, e.g. "6.5 / 10 · IMDb". If the model has no scale field, read the scale from where MB-01 defines it. **Do not add a field to the `CatalogAdapter` contract.** If source or scale is missing from the contract altogether, record it under Open questions and default to `/ 10` only when the contract documents a 0–10 scale.
- Placeholders. Each one is visible text with the same styling as the line it replaces, never an empty node:
  - No poster: a `surface-elevated` box with the same aspect ratio, showing "No poster" and labelled for screen readers (`role="img"` plus `aria-label="No poster available for {title}"`).
  - No year: "Year unknown".
  - No rating: "Not rated".
- If `catalog-display.ts` already produces any of these strings, keep its wording and leave the function signature alone.

### 5 — Header on browse

- Brand name, logo, and nav items must keep coming from `app-config.ts`. Remove any brand or nav string that is hard-coded in browse markup.
- Change only colours and spacing, using tokens. Nav links follow the focus and touch-target rules.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **No MB-01 theme module found** (Task 0). Stop and report. Do not build a new token system inside this story.
- **Header rendered in the app shell.** The scope will not reach it. Use the route-conditional attribute from Task 2, and check that auth and dashboard routes never get `data-theme="browse"`.
- **Contrast.** Approximate ratios worked out during planning:
  - `border-control #71839E` vs `bg`: about 4.9:1. vs `surface-elevated`: about 3.6:1. Both pass the 3:1 UI threshold.
  - `border-decorative #34425A` vs `bg`: about **1.9:1, which fails 3:1**. Never use it as the only boundary of an interactive control.
  - Text tokens on all three surface tokens are well above 4.5:1. Re-check them with axe.
  - Fix any failing pair by changing which token is used, not the token value.
- **Cyan accent as text on light content.** The accent is only used on the dark tokens, so this should not occur. Do not put `on-accent` text anywhere except on an `accent` background.
- **Focus ring clipped** by `overflow: hidden` on cards or the grid. Use `outline-offset` and make sure the parents have room (padding ≥ `--space-1`), or move the focus to the card's link element.
- **44px minimum makes chips taller.** Expected. Check that the grid does not overflow at a 320px viewport width.
- **Null poster with an image error** (the URL exists but fails to load). Showing the placeholder on the `(error)` event is optional. Do not add new remote image sources.
- **Very long titles or unicode.** Clamp to two lines with `-webkit-line-clamp`. Do not truncate the text in the DOM.
- **Reduced motion.** The global `!important` override covers component-scoped transitions. Check this in DevTools by emulating `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Angular style encapsulation.** Component styles reading `var(--…)` resolve from the host's ancestors, so the host attribute (Task 2) is enough.
- **Uncertainty: rating source label.** It is open in the intake. If the fixture has no source field, show the label from whatever MB-01 documents and flag it.

## Test Plan

Follow the existing patterns in `browse.component.spec.ts` and `catalog-display.spec.ts`.

1. **Unit — `catalog-display.spec.ts`:** add cases for rating formatting (value + scale + source, e.g. "6.5 / 10 · IMDb") and for null rating ("Not rated") and null year ("Year unknown"). Add them only if the formatting lives here.
2. **Unit — `browse.component.spec.ts`:**
   - the host element has `data-theme="browse"`.
   - a card with null poster, year, or rating renders the labelled placeholders (query the text and `aria-label`).
   - the rating text matches `/\d+(\.\d+)? \/ \d+ · \S+/`.
   - brand name and nav items equal the values from the platform config (override the config provider the same way `app-config.spec.ts` does).
3. **Unit — non-browse isolation:** a spec (or an extension of `guards.spec.ts`/`app.spec.ts`) that renders the auth layout and asserts there is no `data-theme="browse"` ancestor.
4. **Static check (manual or CI script):** grep `src/app/features/browse/` for `#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8}\b`, `\b\d+px\b` and `font-size:\s*\d`. Expect zero matches.
5. **Manual accessibility:** run axe/Lighthouse on `/browse`. Expect no contrast or target-size violations.
6. **Visual:** no snapshot or visual test setup appears in the repository tree. If none exists, compare screenshots of `/login` and `/register` (or the dashboard) by hand, before and after.

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend builds:** in `MoviePlatform/Frontend/frontend layer/`, run `npm run build` (check the script name in `package.json`).
2. **Frontend tests:** in the same folder, run `npm test` (or `npx ng test --watch=false` for Karma).
3. **Frontend runs:** `npm start` (or `npx ng serve --proxy-config proxy.conf.json`). Open `/browse` and a non-browse route side by side.
4. **Regression:** non-browse routes are unchanged (screenshot comparison). Tab through `/browse`: every focusable element shows a 3px yellow ring with a 3px offset. Toggle reduced motion in DevTools and confirm no transitions run.
5. **Backend:** no changes. `dotnet build` in `MoviePlatform/backendLayer/` is not required.
